about: Private companies (OpenAI, Stripe, Catalent ...) named in real SEC annual reports, read by hand. links: every link the filing readers produced for a scratch registry of private companies over 1,150 annual reports (the sentence is quoted from the filing; label right = the sentence makes the private company the filer's supplier, or its customer with the stated share, wrong = it does not, doubtful = plausible but not settled by the sentence). near_misses: sentences that name a private company and must not produce a link (competitor lists, investments, auditors, pay consultants, underwriters, hypotheticals, sales channels, vendor-concentration figures). known_misses: true statements the readers do not read yet (recall). set: tuning = the filings the rules were tuned on (so a ceiling), cold = filings read before any rule was written for them. The registry is a scratch registry for the evaluation, not the real one.
